title: Upscale AI Launches Token Fabric to Make Rival AI Chips Work Together
source_used: Upscale press release of 8 Oct 2026 (HPCwire page returned a Cloudflare block)
key_facts: Upscale, Inc., a Santa Clara AI networking company, introduced Token Fabric on 8 Oct 2026 (press release); HPCwire covered it on 13 Oct.
Token Fabric unifies scale-up and scale-out networking with common software, to connect accelerators from different makers over open standards.
Parts: SkyFabriX scale-up switch silicon (115.2 Tbps, multi-petabit roadmap), scale-up switch trays, scale-out systems built on Nvidia Spectrum-X, SkyOS network software and SkyCMD orchestration.
Nvidia's Gilad Shainer, senior vice president of networking, and TSMC North America's Lucas Tsai are quoted in support.
General availability is planned for early 2027; early-access and joint-validation programmes are under way.
The release says the architecture is gaining traction across customer wins but names no customers.
quote_evidence: Upscale, Inc., the pure-play AI networking infrastructure company, today introduced Upscale Token Fabric for AI factories.
General availability is planned for early 2027, with early-access and joint-validation programs underway today.
For scale-out, Upscale-engineered systems are built on NVIDIA Spectrum-X silicon.
why_it_matters_hint: An open networking stack aims to let AI operators mix chips from different makers.
notes: Older news: the launch was on 8 Oct 2026 (company press release); HPCwire's 13 Oct story re-reports it. Claims are Upscale's own. Upscale's site also lists a USD 190 million Series A extension on 22 Jun 2026 bringing total funding to half a billion dollars.
